versions.content: After sending an alive check request the DoIP module shall wait the configured time DoIPAliveCheckResponseTimeout to receive a valid alive check response as described in chapter 7.3.2.4.2 . If it does not receive an alive check response, the socket connection on which the alive check request was sent shall be closed as described in SWS_DoIP_00058.
